# Observatory on Social Media

> > A research center uniting data scientists and journalists at Indiana University to study media, technology, disinformation, and social bots through advanced analysis tools and open-source software.

OSoMe conducts rigorous research on social media dynamics, misinformation detection, and coordinated inauthentic behavior. The center develops publicly accessible tools and datasets while offering educational programs in media literacy and computational social science.

## Key Topics

- social-media-analysis
- bot-detection
- misinformation-detection
- social-bots

## Core Resources

- [Home](https://osome.iu.edu): OSoMe homepage: Research center uniting data scientists and journalists studying media, technology, and disinformation.
- [Tools](https://osome.iu.edu/resources/tools): OSoMe tools for bot detection, network visualization, and misinformation analysis including OSoMeNet and Coordiscope.
- [Education](https://osome.iu.edu/education): OSoMe educational programs: undergraduate courses, graduate certificates, and media literacy training.

## Data & APIs

- [Data Resources](https://osome.iu.edu/resources/data-resources): OSoMe datasets and APIs including Botometer Pro for social media research and analysis.
- [Publication Data](https://osome.iu.edu/resources/publication-data): Datasets from OSoMe research projects on Twitter, Bluesky, elections, and social bots available via Zenodo.
- [Open Source](https://osome.iu.edu/resources/open-source): OSoMe GitHub repositories with open-source software for bot detection, misinformation research, and analysis.

## Research & Publications

- [White Papers](https://osome.iu.edu/research/white-papers): OSoMe white papers and reports on misinformation detection, Twitter analysis, and information manipulation.
- [Blog](https://osome.iu.edu/research/blog): OSoMe blog with updates on research, tools, funding, and academic conference participation.
- [Media](https://osome.iu.edu/media): Media coverage of OSoMe research on Twitter bots, misinformation, and election analysis.

## Community & Events

- [OSoMe Awesome Speakers](https://osome.iu.edu/events): OSoMe Awesome Speakers virtual event series featuring scholars discussing social media and disinformation.
